# routeur_project (Resource)

A project in a workspace. API keys belong to one project, and routing rules, policies and budgets can be scoped to one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "routeur_workspace" "payments" {
  slug = "payments"
  name = "Payments"
}

resource "routeur_project" "checkout" {
  workspace_id = routeur_workspace.payments.id
  slug         = "checkout"
  name         = "Checkout"
  description  = "The checkout service."
}

resource "routeur_project" "fraud" {
  workspace_id = routeur_workspace.payments.id
  slug         = "fraud-screening"
  name         = "Fraud screening"
  enabled      = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name, 1–80 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace.
- `slug` (String) Unique in the organisation. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 60 characters. Set at create only; changing it replaces the project.
- `workspace_id` (String) Id of the workspace this belongs to (`ws_…`), e.g. `routeur_workspace.example.id`. The `routeur_workspace` data source resolves a slug to its id. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description, at most 255 characters. Stored verbatim; `""` stays `""`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the project is enabled. Defaults to `true`; removing the argument enables the project again.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `id` (String) Public id of the project (`proj_…`).
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the workspace's default project, which cannot be disabled or deleted.
- `updated_at` (String) When it was last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# id: <workspace_id>/<project_id>
import {
  to = routeur_project.checkout
  id = "ws_3/proj_12"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <workspace_id>/<project_id>
terraform import routeur_project.checkout ws_3/proj_12
```
